title: multivr
description: this modpack adds for a seamless multiplayer experience between vr and pc!
body:
This modpack is built to seamlessly unite PC and VR players into one shared Minecraft experience, focusing on performance, immersion, and smooth cross-play.

At its core, it combines powerful optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Essential to ensure stable performance for both desktop and VR users. Whether you're playing on a standard setup or inside a headset, the game runs faster, smoother, and more reliably.

Vivecraft brings full VR support, allowing players to physically interact with the world—swinging tools, aiming naturally, and experiencing Minecraft from a whole new perspective. Meanwhile, PC players can join the same world without compromise, keeping gameplay fair and enjoyable for everyone.

Simple Voice Chat adds proximity-based communication, making multiplayer feel more natural and immersive. Talk to nearby players as if you’re actually there, whether they’re in VR or on keyboard and mouse.

Overall, this modpack is designed to bridge the gap between two ways of playing—bringing PC precision and VR immersion together into one optimized, social, and highly interactive Minecraft experience.
